authority: This catalog records the OpenMAIC vendor intake result: pinned upstream identity, license boundaries, discovered capability inventory, and selective projection. It extends capabilities.json and the existing vendor provenance mechanism (.p2p/vendor/provenance/). It does NOT create a second ontology, registry, router, projection, provider catalog, or governance system. OpenMAIC internal multi-agent classroom/teacher/peer agents are VENDOR_INTERNAL_ONLY education semantics; P2P retains Control Tower authority, Work Factory, capability routing, execution lanes, Supervisor, Owner Gate, Git/evidence truth, BackendExecutionBridge, and ReturnPacket.

candidates.rationale: Pinned, selectively projectable education/course-production vendor candidate. Vendor intake only: no install, no runtime, no classroom generation, no downstream modification. Complete vendor capability/model catalog is NOT duplicated into P2P.
candidates.security_notes: Static bounded review only. Observed: server-side credentials only; SSRF guard (hostname + DNS-pinned IP classification, redirect-safe); bounded downloads/uploads; ACCESS_CODE HMAC auth opt-in; CSP frame-ancestors; agent workbench is opt-in and PostgreSQL-backed by design. Generated interactive HTML runs in learner browser - containment review deferred to execution-registration gate.
boundary: vendor-internal multi-agent classroom is NOT a P2P orchestration or review authority
browser-only default requires no database; durable agent sessions require opt-in PostgreSQL runtime
20+ built-in skills are vendor course tools, not first-class P2P capabilities
